# Baselines

Pinned reference data used by regression tests.

## rag_eval_baseline_v1.json

Pinned RAG retrieval-quality baseline from the first stable nightly batch
after Step 0 of the retrieval optimization plan 2026.

**Generated by:** `npm run rag:eval:pin-baseline` (added in a follow-up PR
after the first 7 days of nightly batches accumulate enough data).

**Used by:** `src/tests/regression/rag_baseline.regression.test.ts` — fails
if `faithfulness_avg` for any (profile × embedding_model) combination drops
by more than 0.03 from the pinned baseline.

**Refresh policy:** Update the pinned baseline ONLY when a retrieval change
is deliberately scoped to lower a metric (rare). Otherwise, treat regression
test failures as regressions to fix in code, not as baselines to update.

This is the gate-IS-the-spec rule applied to retrieval quality.
